english_lines: The place we are going is not very far—come.
Joy wells up in my heart!
You will find a joy greater even than this;
Merging your life with nature, you will behold the heavens there—come.
notes: The verified joined form `கலந்துயிர்` is translated conservatively without changing the Tamil.

english_lines: An imperishable state of silence surrounds us!
That endless state of silence—you will
See it at the mountain's end; come.
Upon the summit, let us behold matchless beauty
Finding happiness and forgetting this world,
You will behold another world there!
I follow like a tiger—you, young deer, come!
notes: The predator/deer image in `புலியெனத் ... புதுமான்` is preserved because it is narratively charged and source-visible.

translator_notes: The printed heading names `மந்திரிகுமாரி`, while the source turn label inside the block is `அமுதவல்லி`; the translation preserves both exactly and does not normalize the mismatch.
Item-level lyric authorship remains unresolved at this booklet-evidence tier; translation does not upgrade attribution.
